notes: Krishna district was not changed by the Dec 2025 reorganisation (The Hindu). The current division-wise list comes from the 'new_mandals' page (12 + 7 + 7 = 26 mandals, matching the home page count of 26), which shows Machilipatnam mandal split into Machilipatnam North and Machilipatnam South. Other pages on the same site are stale and should be ignored: /mandals/ and /revenue-divisions/ show the pre-2022 undivided district (53 mandals, 4 divisions), and /revenue-land-administration/ has a mixed list that places Gannavaram, Bapulapadu and Unguturu under Vuyyuru and still includes Tiruvuru (now in NTR). The about page says 25 mandals and 3 municipalities, which predates the Machilipatnam split and the Tadigadapa municipality. Machilipatnam division is also called Bandar. Vuyyuru is a municipality per the district site but appears as a town panchayat in the PMAY 2.0 list; the district classification is used. The district site names the fifth ULB 'Y S R Tadigadapa' (Grade-1 municipality); a third-party 2026 election listing shows it as 'Tadigadapa', and any official rename was not verified. The district site labels Machilipatnam as a municipality, but PMAY 2.0 lists it as a municipal corporation, which is used here.
